flora: Giant Mamaku trees (20 meters tall, thick black trunks, massive spreading crowns)
Early Birch-like trees (providing a white-barked contrast)
Low ferns and mosses on ash-grey rocks
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; massive scale; creating a sense of a 'vertical' forest; the black trunks standing out against the light grey volcanic background.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view from the shore of a volcanic lake. Giant black tree ferns dominate the mid-ground, their crowns overlapping to form a dense canopy. The ground is a mix of whitish tuff and grey ash. In the background, a volcanic peak is visible through the hazy light.
visual_logic.ground: Sloping ground of light ash grey volcanic soil with buff-colored rocky outcrops.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright but hazy sunlight, as if filtered through volcanic particulate, casting soft shadows and highlighting the deep black of the Mamaku trunks.
